title: Inferno
description: At the start of your turn, lose [blue]1[/blue] HP. Whenever you lose HP on your turn, deal [blue]4[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
smart_description: At the start of your turn, lose [blue]{SelfDamage}[/blue] HP. Whenever you lose HP on your turn, deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
notes: This is a scaling buff power. The SelfDamage amount (shown as 1 in the base description) can be incremented, increasing the self-damage cost each turn while maintaining the same damage output to enemies. Both the self-damage and enemy damage are applied as unblockable damage.
